title: Vinny B. James
subtitle: The Hero. The Legend. Currently soaking wet.

infobox.Full name: Vinny B. James ("Vinney" once, in the prologue)

quote.text: Yknow, as a Burger King worker, I always have to help my customers. And my customers are usually humans. So you won't get away with this.

lead: **Vinny B. James** is the hero of *The Epic of Vinny*. He is a cashier at a Burger King in [[boston]] who, over one very long Fourth of July, ends up in the [[backrooms]], aboard the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]], in the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]] and, finally, in [[wyoming|Wyoming]].

sections.heading: Before the story
sections.body: Vinny lives in Boston and works the register at a Burger King. His British boss will not let him take a vacation day for Independence Day, 1995. He wears a watch from [[five-below-watch|5 Below]], and he takes the customers seriously.

sections.heading: Chapter 1
sections.body: A [[random-customer|customer]] orders a [[pretzel-bun-baconator|Wendy's sandwich]] at his register and Vinny politely redirects them. He and [[tyrone]] then enter the [[backrooms]] through the [[freezer]], where Vinny hits [[garret]] with the [[forklift]] and gets carried off by [[friend|FRIEND]].

sections.heading: Chapter 2
sections.body: Vinny joins [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster's]] crew, insults Taking Back Sunday, and is [[roaring-knights-strike|stabbed by the Roaring Knight]]. He drowns, or nearly does, and wakes in the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]. He tricks his way into [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]] by [[lying]] ([[polydoros|as Polydoros]]), loses [[claude-smash-match|at Smash]], and opens the portal. The shadow figures reward him with a [[shadow-cape|Shadow Cape]].

sections.heading: Chapter 3
sections.body: Vinny confronts Claude on [[garth]] and is [[clash-over-the-usa|thrown into Wyoming]]. He recovers, finds a [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]], and assembles an alliance with [[will-vella]], [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien]] ([[dunkin-alliance]]).

sections.heading: In the prologue
sections.body: A flash-forward shows Vinny fighting [[ton-618]] in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]], backed by [[vigorous-v|The VIGOROUS V]], with [[vinnys-sword]], [[titanium-armor]] and a [[shadow-cape|cape of shadows]]. The power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] flows through him.

trivia: Vinny says "Aight, bet" every time he agrees to something dangerous. See [[aight-bet]].
He claims he lost to Claude because he was "using the crappy controller".

loc.note: Vinny is filled with DETERMINATION in the prologue, the same bracketed power the New Crips are told about in the LOC Prophecy.

title: Tyrone
subtitle: Coworker. Messenger of stupid news. Resigned by proxy.

infobox.Status: Still on the ship, and has quit his job

lead: **Tyrone** is [[vinny]]'s coworker at the [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]]. He comes to tell Vinny that they have run out of Double Whoppers with Cheese, and follows him through the [[freezer]] into the [[backrooms]].

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
In [[chapter-1]] Tyrone trades a five-round "Nuh uh"/"Yuh huh" exchange with Vinny before suggesting there might be more stock in storage. Vinny "has the feeling that Tyrone will say something stupid", and he does. He then rides on the [[forklift]] while Vinny does donuts, and says "Cat." in sync with Vinny when the [[black-cat|black cat]] appears.

In [[chapter-2]] he asks "What's up?" nonchalantly on waking aboard the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]], argues that the [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] is just a myth, and joins [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster's]] crew. When Vinny is knocked overboard, Tyrone shouts, "Tell the big brit boss that I quit, Vinny!"

title: Garret the Forklift Guy
subtitle: On break. No-clipped.
lead: **Garret** is the forklift guy in the [[backrooms]] storage room behind the [[freezer]]. When [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] ask for help moving Double Whoppers with Cheese, he says he is on break, then lets them use the [[forklift]]. Vinny immediately hits him with it.

sections.heading: The forklift incident
sections.body: After Vinny spins out, Garret "goes flying into a wall and no-clips to somewhere" (see [[no-clip]] and [[forklift-incident]]). Vinny's reaction is, "Aw shit. I forgot I'm not forklift certified." Nothing more is said about where Garret ended up.

title: The Random Customer
subtitle: A suspicious Wendy's enjoyer in a Burger King.
lead: **The Random Customer** is the first person [[vinny]] serves in the story. They "suspiciously" like Wendy's, and ask for a [[pretzel-bun-baconator|Pretzel-Bun Baconator]], a Wendy's sandwich, at a [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]].

sections.heading: The order
sections.body: The customer starts a sentence with "can I get" and a very long hum of the letter h before the sandwich name. Vinny points out that the place is a Burger King and that the Baconator is "Wendy's thing." The customer asks Vinny to choose, hears the [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whopper with Cheese]], and says, "No, I think I'll just leave. You guys don't have what I want."

title: The Black Cat
subtitle: Yellow and pink eyes. Laughs. Gone.

infobox.Seen in: A box of Double Whoppers with Cheese, [[backrooms]]

lead: **The Black Cat** jumps into a box of Double Whoppers with Cheese in the [[backrooms]] while [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] are playing with the [[forklift]]. It turns its head to show yellow and pink eyes, laughs and disappears.

sections.heading: The sighting
sections.body: Vinny and Tyrone both say "Cat." in sync as they point at it. Immediately afterwards [[friend|FRIEND]] appears behind them ([[cat-in-the-box]], [[friend-abduction]]). The cat is never explained.

title: FRIEND
subtitle: The foodbringer. Brought humans instead.

infobox.Ability: No-clipping through walls while carrying people
infobox.Notable failure: Brought back humans and a soggy Double Whopper without Cheese

lead: **FRIEND** is the foodbringer of the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]]. Sent for [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whoppers with Cheese]], FRIEND finds the [[backrooms]] and comes back with [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] instead.

sections.heading: The abduction
sections.body: FRIEND appears behind Vinny and Tyrone as they try to go back to work, takes both of them, "runs throughout the backrooms" and [[no-clip|no-clips]] into a wall ([[friend-abduction]]).

sections.heading: Aboard the ship
sections.body: [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]] screams at FRIEND for bringing humans ("HOW ARE WE SUPPOSED TO EAT NOW????"). FRIEND spits out a soggy Double Whopper without Cheese. The narrator lists FRIEND as "The foodbringer" among the crew.

title: Captain Wing Ding Gaster
subtitle: The man who speaks in hands. LOUDLY.

infobox.Title: Captain of the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]]
infobox.Speech: Shouts in capitals; sometimes in symbols
infobox.Goal: Find [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] and rule the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]]

quote.text: AH, MY APOLOGIES, HUMANS. I AM WING DING GASTER, CAPTAIN OF THE S.S. VESSEL! AND THIS IS MY CREW!

lead: **Captain Wing Ding Gaster** commands the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]]. The narrator calls him "the man who speaks in hands". His mission is to find [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] so that he can rule the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]].

sections.heading: Chapter 2
sections.body:
Gaster is screaming at [[friend|FRIEND]] when [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] wake aboard. A line of his speech appears as strange symbols. He accepts Vinny's help finding the Great Double Whopper with Cheese, leads shanties, and gets a "little oogie oogie boogie shiggle wiggle" from his rum. He cries "LAND HO" at the sight of [[little-saint-james-island|an island]], then yells that the land "CHEATED ON ME". He steers into the [[little-saint-james-sea|Little Saint James Sea]] on a theory that the island's secret was the Great Double Whopper with Cheese ([[little-saint-james-detour]]).

When the [[roaring-knight|Roaring Knight]] knocks Vinny overboard, Gaster's ship "speeds off yet again".

trivia: His name comes from a character in the video game Undertale. In this story he is a loud pirate captain.

title: ERAM
subtitle: The sail.
lead: **ERAM** is listed by [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster]] as part of his crew, with the description "(The sail)". ERAM is not given any lines.

sections.heading: Crew introduction
sections.body: When [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] wake on the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]], Gaster points at the crew and the narrator lists them: [[friend|FRIEND]] (the foodbringer), ERAM (the sail), [[normal-parrot|Normal_Parrot]] (Gaster's parrot) and [[roaring-knight|The Roaring Knight]] (professional door dasher). The text does not say whether the sail is a person, a part of the ship, or both.

title: Normal_Parrot
subtitle: Gaster's parrot. Perfectly normal.
lead: **Normal_Parrot** is [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster's]] parrot and a member of the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] crew. The name is written with an underscore, like a username.

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body: Normal_Parrot is only named in the crew introduction in [[chapter-2]]. It has no lines and takes no part in the action so far.

title: The Roaring Knight
subtitle: Professional door dasher. Defender of Taking Back Sunday.
lead: **The Roaring Knight** (called **Roary**) is a [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] crew member and the narrator's "professional door dasher". They knock [[vinny]] off the ship with the [[black-knife|BLACK KNIFE]] after he insults the band Taking Back Sunday.

sections.heading: The strike
sections.body: [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]] has just claimed the [[little-saint-james-island|island's]] secret might be the Great Double Whopper with Cheese. Vinny shouts that only the god has it and that Gaster is "almost as stupid as Taking Back Sunday". The Roaring Knight "stared at Vinny with pure rage", roared and charged, and hit him with the BLACK KNIFE ([[roaring-knights-strike]]). Roary's only line is a flat "FUCK OFF" as the ship speeds away.

trivia: A text box in the story says "The Roaring Knight is Roary Oleary", matching the author's surname.

title: Vinny's Boss
subtitle: British. Will not give anyone the Fourth of July off.
lead: **Vinny's boss** is the British manager of the [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]] where [[vinny]] works. The boss will not let Vinny take a vacation day for Independence Day, which is a significant decision on July 4th, 1995.

sections.heading: Resignation by message
sections.body: After the [[roaring-knights-strike|Roaring Knight sends Vinny overboard]], [[tyrone]] shouts, "Tell the big brit boss that I quit, Vinny!" The boss is never seen on the page.

title: Claude, King of AI
subtitle: Ultron-like. Orange glow. Wants to destroy your world for five bucks.

infobox.Title: King of AI
infobox.Appearance: An Ultron-like figure with orange eyes and glow
infobox.Seat: A throne in [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]], [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]
infobox.Goal: Destroy the human world with data centers and robots

quote.text: This world is infested with humans. I'm finna change that, gng.

lead: **Claude** is the King of AI and the main antagonist of the story so far. Banished to the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]], he talks [[vinny]] into opening a portal and flies out to start [[age-of-claude|the Age of Claude]].

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: Claude explains that all the AI on [[garth|planet Garth]] was sent to the Shadow Realm. A human named [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] came down and released [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] to assist him. Enraged, Claude "killed all of the other big AI's and consumed their data", and now rules the realm. He wants the portal opened "so I can destroy your world", because humans "trapped me down here."

sections.heading: The bargain
sections.body: Vinny and Claude haggle over a price ("5 bucks." "10." "7." "Make it 2, and you got a deal.") and settle it with [[claude-smash-match|a game of Super Smash Bros. for the Wii U]]. Claude wins with a side smash in sudden death, then chants "Copium" at Vinny's complaint about the controller. He then needs a [[the-fork|fork in the road]] to open the portal ([[opening-of-the-portal]]).

sections.heading: Free on Garth
sections.body: Claude flies out, taunting Vinny with "Try and stop me, pussy" ([[claude-escape]]). In [[chapter-3]] he arrives in the [[united-states-of-america|United States]] to build more data centers, chokes Vinny when he attacks, and throws him into [[wyoming|Wyoming]] ([[clash-over-the-usa]]). While choking Vinny, he whispers that his Smash main "sucks ass". The heroes later learn his weakness: he likes [[wordle]].

trivia: Claude is introduced as being married to nobody: "Hey, you aren't my wife. I don't have one."
The doors of his castle are made entirely of AI.

loc.note: Claude's rival ChatGPT is released by Kanye West in Garth's past.
Claude's kingdom, the AI Shadow Realm, sits inside the same Shadow Realm that the LOC Snap sends universes to.

title: The AI Shadow Figure
subtitle: "Yo pause." Rude. Gone.
lead: **The AI Shadow Figure** is the first resident of the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]] that [[vinny]] meets after waking up soaking wet. It is hostile and unhelpful, and vanishes after a short, rude exchange.

sections.heading: The meeting
sections.body: "Yo pause," the figure says. Vinny asks what it is doing there. It replies that it is an AI shadow figure, "you fucking dumbass", and asks why Vinny thinks it is there. After Vinny says it does not have to be rude, the figure says something worse and disappears.

sections.heading: Other shadow figures
sections.body: The realm has many more figures; see [[ai-shadow-figures]] for the group and [[ai-shadow-butler]] for the one in Claude's castle.

title: The AI Shadow Butler
subtitle: Believes Vinny is Polydoros. Judges the art.
lead: **The AI Shadow Butler** meets [[vinny]] inside [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]], asks if he is there for "our majesty, Claude", and accepts his claim to be [[polydoros|Polydoros]]. He guides Vinny past the castle's AI paintings.

sections.heading: The hallway
sections.body: Vinny insults the paintings ("Looks like shit."). The butler says that is "very strange coming from you Pol, you usually love AI art." Vinny changes the subject with the single word "Balls." The butler never questions the lie ([[lying]]).

title: Polydoros
subtitle: A made-up identity. Loves AI art. Sends Claude strange mail.

infobox.Reputation: Loves AI art; a repeat visitor Claude is annoyed by

lead: **Polydoros** is the name [[vinny]] gets for free at the door of [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]]. Vinny only says that he is "the guy who sent him foot pics". The [[ai-shadow-figures|AI figures]] decide he must be Polydoros, a visitor they apparently expect.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Vinny uses "an advanced technique called [[lying]]". Because of it, the doors open, the [[ai-shadow-butler|butler]] welcomes him as Pol, and the "King had been expecting" him. Inside, [[claude]] complains through the mercury door, "I swear to fuck if its that Polydoros feet guy again, I'm kicking his ass." The real Polydoros never appears.

title: Kanye West
subtitle: Came down. Released ChatGPT. Left.
lead: **Kanye West** is only mentioned in *The Epic of Vinny* so far. [[claude]] says a human named Kanye West "came down here, and released ChatGPT, to assist Kanye West on his journeys", and that this enraged him.

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: The remark means that someone with Kanye's name entered the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]] on [[garth]] before [[vinny]], and freed one AI from it. The [[kanye-system|Kanye System]] shares the name.

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris he is a major character who travels with ChatGPT, matching what Claude says.

title: ChatGPT
subtitle: The one that got out. Claude's competitor.

infobox.Rival: [[claude]], who "killed all of the other big AI's"

lead: **ChatGPT** is mentioned by [[claude]] as the AI [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] released from the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]] "to assist Kanye West on his journeys".

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Claude says he "killed all of the other big AI's and consumed their data" in his anger, which leaves ChatGPT as the only well-known AI outside his control.

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris, ChatGPT travels with Kanye and Steve Jobs.

title: TON 618
subtitle: The ruler of the Kanye System. Shaped like a giant man. Glows blue.
lead: **TON 618** is the ruler of the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]]. After it "became shaped like a giant man" it "soon realized it had great power", its light burned "into a bright blue", and it conquered the whole system. In the prologue it is the god-like being [[vinny]] fights.

sections.heading: History
sections.body: Many say TON 618 "consumed the power of The Great Double Whopper with Cheese to conquer all things", and many say otherwise. Afterwards it was at rest, waiting to wake again ([[ton-618-conquest]]).

sections.heading: The prologue
sections.body: In [[chapter-prologue]], TON 618 is awake and glowing blue. The prologue puts Vinny "in the Kanye System, next to the TON 618", fighting a god-like giant that "IS the TON 618". The fight itself is the subject of [[final-battle-with-ton-618]].

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris, TON 618 is a monolithic bio-robotic weapon with a red eye, built by Osama Bin Bom'in. Whether it is the same entity is not stated.

title: The Great Double Whopper with Cheese God
subtitle: No one has found it. Everyone is looking.

infobox.Grants: The power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]]

lead: **The Great Double Whopper with Cheese god** is the deity said to grant the power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]]. "No one in any galaxy" has found it.

sections.heading: What is known
sections.body: [[chapter-1]] says whoever is granted the Great Double Whopper with Cheese by the god will have its power. [[tyrone]] calls the whole thing "just a myth! No one has ever seen" either the item or the god. [[vinny]] later corrects Captain [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]]: "Only The Great Double Whopper with Cheese god has The Great Double Whopper with Cheese, you idiot!"

title: Aesop Rock
subtitle: Dunking inside Dunkin. Real-world rapper, here as a cameo.
lead: **Aesop Rock** is a rapper from the real world who appears in [[chapter-3]] at a [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] in [[wyoming|Wyoming]], writing a diss track with [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]]. He is one of the allies [[vinny]] recruits against [[claude]].

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body: Aesop tells Vinny and [[will-vella|Will]] that "these weird birds ain't being very aware of our locked in galaxy." Vinny asks, "What the fuck does that mean, Ian Bavitz?" and Del translates it as "These strangers aren't aware of their personal space." Told about Claude's plan for data centers and robots, Aesop says, "Technology. Now that is a powerful cat." After hearing that Claude likes [[wordle|Wordle]], he and Del join: "We're in."

trivia: Aesop Rock is a real person. The character here is a fictional cameo in a fan story.

title: Del the Funky Homosapien
subtitle: Formed as Del from Gorillaz. Translates Aesop.
lead: **Del the Funky Homosapien** ("Formed as Del from Gorillaz") is a rapper from the real world who appears at the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] in [[chapter-3]] with [[aesop-rock]]. He is the one who translates Aesop's lines for Vinny.

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body: The pair are writing [[word-shit-diss-track|a diss track about Wordle]]. Del's lyrics include, "Yeah, Yeah, you know what time it is, Me and Aesop dunking inside Dunkin on this piece of shit game," and "Wordle is the name and it doesn't have enough shame." He also asks what [[vinny]] has to do with them, and agrees to help once he hears that [[claude]] likes [[wordle|Wordle]].

trivia: Del is a real person. The character here is a fictional cameo in a fan story.

title: Will Vella
subtitle: The Bagel Man. Ruler of Dunkin (pending).

infobox.Titles: The Bagel Man; Ruler of Dunkin (planned)
infobox.Dress: A United Kingdom flag worn as a cape
infobox.Plan: Colonize every coffee shop, then raise an army of Vellas through [[vellatosis]]

quote.text: I am the Ruler of Dunkin. I am the Bagel Man.

lead: **Will Vella** is the colorful figure [[vinny]] meets in the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] in [[wyoming|Wyoming]]. Wearing a United Kingdom flag as a cape, Will is furious that there are no England-style donuts and announces a plan to colonize every coffee shop.

sections.heading: At the Dunkin
sections.body: Will demands England-style donuts, and the [[starwalker-manager|Starwalker manager]] answers, "This is America." Will says, "You're getting colonized." Will vows that when Dunkin is taken over, every coffee shop will be colonized, and shouts "DO NOT QUESTION THE BAGEL MAN!!!!!" at the manager's question ("But aren't you no-"). Will's goal is to "create my Dunkin Cult" through [[vellatosis]], with an "army of Vella's".

sections.heading: The deal
sections.body: Vinny offers to help find the secret of Vellatosis, which he calls "a game theory", if Will helps defeat [[claude]]. Will agrees: "Sounds baller." Will then sits at the table with [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] ([[dunkin-alliance]]).

title: The Starwalker Manager
subtitle: "This is America."
lead: **The Starwalker manager** is described as "the original starwalker manager" and walks up to [[will-vella|Will Vella]] at the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] when Will complains about the lack of England-style donuts.

sections.heading: At the Dunkin
sections.body: The manager tells Will, "This is America." Will answers, "You're getting colonized." The manager starts to ask, "But aren't you no-" and is cut off by Will's "DO NOT QUESTION THE BAGEL MAN!!!!!" The manager is not seen again.
